exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithful HD PAINTED GAME diffuse UV texture.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE native stored RGB edit target 256x128. Image2 is ONLY that identical whole source enlarged4x with nearest pixels, to expose the existing tiny paint pattern. Both are the same single canvas. Output ENTIRE same aspect 256:128 canvas and UV, same orientation, no margin/crop/padding/repacking/rotation/zoom. Original full selected alpha restored numerically after this edit.

Preserve this entire wide original atlas: left gray field and old brown angular camo fragments at source count/scale/phase, original narrow brown vertical border, broad black-gray central diffuse field and only its original soft diagonal wash folds, right brown narrow border and dark right strip with old muted marks, source lower black-gray horizontal wash. Keep exactly the original dark gaps and cutoff shapes; no new folds, grain, fasteners, tread, shiny rims or brighter weak marks.

Only improve painted resolution inside the EXISTING shapes. Preserve original palette, matte or shiny material, low contrast and brush softness, relative local lights, all original black gaps/cutouts, and pattern count and scale. Do not redraw little marks into new symbols, add weave/thread/grain/pores/stitches, new folds, bright bevels or hardware. No photograph, new anatomy, new text or new objects. This must remain a faithful old painted game UV texture, no portrait or assembled garment.
